prompts.swordsman:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production chibi pixel RPG TURNAROUND atlas for Ayothaya Folk Mystic. Input image is identity, costume and pixel-art style REFERENCE ONLY, not a pose template. Create exactly SIXTEEN separated full-body sprites in FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows on true transparent background. Square canvas, ideally 2048x2048. Every cell has equal dimensions, 8% transparent padding, feet centered at 92% cell height, full weapons/head/feet visible, identical body scale.
The layout is EXACT:
ROW 1 MALE: column 1 STRAIGHT FRONT facing viewer south; column 2 front-right three-quarter southeast; column 3 strict RIGHT PROFILE east; column 4 BACK-RIGHT three-quarter northeast, nose points RIGHT, back mostly visible.
ROW 2 SAME MALE: column 1 STRAIGHT BACK north (no face, no nose); column 2 BACK-LEFT three-quarter northwest, nose points LEFT; column 3 strict LEFT PROFILE west; column 4 FRONT-LEFT three-quarter southwest, nose points LEFT and front torso visible.
ROW 3 FEMALE: same directions as row 1 (S, SE, E, NE).
ROW 4 SAME FEMALE: same directions as row 2 (N, NW, W, SW).
Each set is ONE SAME character rotating in place by 45 degrees. Anatomical hands must stay consistent, NEVER mirror the weapon to the opposite hand. Back views show actual backs of clothing/head. Head and feet follow same direction. Neutral standing only, no attack or walking poses.
Style: match input rich warm Folk Mystic chibi pixel art, 2.5 heads tall, clearly clustered crisp pixels, brown dark outlines, cute readable face, no smooth vector or plastic 3D. NO words, no labels, no grid lines, no ground shadow, no checkerboard, no background scene. Actual alpha transparency.
Character: Thai swordsman male and swordswoman female, indigo quilted lamellar vest, ivory sleeves, gold trim, red sash, navy Thai trousers, ivory ankle wraps, black bun with ivory band and gold ornament. Curved Thai sword in anatomical RIGHT hand, round dark bronze shield in anatomical LEFT hand. Match exact reference.
